rationale: The compiled artifacts faithfully realize the reviewed design: the four planned message_reactions inserts are applied exactly as specified (second match on C_FRONTEND, wrong-emoji negative on C_INFRA, wrong-user negative on C_MODEL, authorship-split negative on C02EFGH5678), all keyed correctly under the (message_id,user_id,reaction_type) primary key with no conflicts. The selector's focal path (channels→messages→message_reactions) with filters user_id=U01AGENBOT9 and reaction_type='eyes' correctly reproduces the two intended matches (C03IJKL9012, C_FRONTEND) and computed_focal_negatives correctly excludes C_INFRA, C_MODEL, and C02EFGH5678 among all other non-matching channels. Agent1's channel_members rows confirm real discoverability of every match/negative channel via users.conversations. Bindings, cards, task_spec, and mechanical_checks agree with the design with zero mechanical errors. Answer attributes (channel_name, channel_id) are legitimate bare columns. No hidden-ID or unsupported-capability issues are introduced during compilation.
